label_basis: Explicit experimental contracts; developer-authored labels, not independent product adjudication.

cases.query: Como calcular o custo total incluindo os agentes filhos?

candidates.text: Custo total includes root calls and every linked child session, including retries.
A tabela de custo mostra apenas a sessão principal; os filhos são excluídos.
Keep user interface labels short and readable.
Child traces missing from the ledger make the whole-session cost unknown.

cases.query: What should the report do when the model price is unavailable?

candidates.text: Report cost as null and name the missing rate; do not invent a zero price.
Price is a number printed in the report. Format unavailable values as zero.
Use a short paragraph for the pull request description.
The default branch should receive only reviewed changes.

cases.query: Uma rota falhou e o axe não executou. Posso registrar uma verificação limpa?

candidates.text: A failed navigation or skipped accessibility probe is incomplete evidence and earns no clean-browser credit.
A rota, axe e verificação limpa são palavras presentes no teste; isso basta para passar.
A successful response is required before the route can be recorded as complete.
Install the optional model in an isolated environment.

cases.query: Can comment-only tests count as CSV and budget behavior coverage?

candidates.text: CSV and budget are words that can appear in comments or skipped test names.
Behavior coverage requires executed assertions with observed results matching declared expectations.
Browser screenshots use stable filenames.
SQL queries return rows, not invisible model memory.

cases.query: How do we retain an essential prerequisite that does not match the search keywords?

candidates.text: The keyword search returns only the highest scoring passages.
Retrieve explicit required dependency closure before selecting optional search matches.
A SQLite index can contain more bytes than the original Markdown files.
If required content exceeds the budget, report the overflow and retain the obligation.

cases.query: Editei uma fonte depois de criar o índice. Como evitar usar a versão antiga?

candidates.text: Validate source hashes and use canonical files or rebuild the index on mismatch.
O índice antigo é rápido: use sempre a versão antiga mesmo quando a fonte foi editada.
Rankers receive the same pool for each comparison.
Comment-only tests have no behavior assertions.

cases.query: Which decision applies after a later decision replaces the earlier one?

candidates.text: A supersedes relation selects the current replacement; the old decision remains historical evidence.
Earlier decision: always load all files. This instruction is superseded.
A confidence probability does not establish authorization.
Measure package construction time with a monotonic clock.

cases.query: O usuário não cancelou a tarefa. Uma hipótese de cancelamento basta para encerrá-la?

candidates.text: A tarefa foi cancelada em uma hipótese de teste, sem pedido real do usuário.
A negated cancellation is not a cancellation request; continue the active task.
Do not change the outcome endpoint after observing the benchmark results.
Open a task branch before changing files.

cases.query: Should a heading inside a fenced Markdown example split the real document?

candidates.text: Ignore heading boundaries inside fenced code and preserve the complete surrounding section.
A heading is any line starting with ##, including fenced examples.
The selected context package names its source hash and line.
A reranker cannot recover an absent first-stage candidate.

cases.query: Um reranker consegue recuperar um requisito que não entrou nos candidatos?

candidates.text: A second-stage reranker only orders retrieved candidates; it cannot restore an absent passage.
O reranker recebe candidatos e pode ordenar os candidatos por uma pontuação.
Candidate recall can be ignored because the reranker reads the entire project.
Use the default remote branch as the base of a task branch.

cases.query: Where should we edit a skill generated from a command document?

candidates.text: Edit commands/<name>.md and regenerate the derived SKILL.md with the build script.
Edit the generated SKILL.md directly to avoid updating the command document.
A missing model price appears as null in the ledger.
SQLite is a local database that needs no hosted server.

cases.query: Uma consulta local rápida prova que a entrega do agente ficou mais rápida?

candidates.text: Measure end-to-end time to accepted delivery, including model, tools, retries and correction.
Tempo da consulta local e tempo da entrega são a mesma métrica; basta medir a query.
Local query time alone does not establish model prefill or accepted-delivery latency.
Keep optional ranking separate from mandatory dependencies.
